projects.title: EPICS II Windjammer Project
projects.description: Assigned to design a handicapped accessible bathroom on a boat.  Windjammer was a company that specialized in getting the handicapped people on the ocean.  The design had to fit into Windjammer boat configurations and had to include shower and regular bathroom features.  Our design was based around a single pivoting swing allowing people missing legs the ability to use the toilet and the shower independantly.  My section involved studying land based swings and trying to integrate these into our design.

projects.title: EPICS I Mars Rover Project
projects.description: Was assigned a project to design Mars rover dirt collection device. This rover was to conform to specifications designated by NASA to collect dirt on Mars while being lightweight, strong and power efficient. Our design was based around using a scoop that went all the way around the rover to maximize efficiency and save battery power.  I was personally responsible for the sifting mechanism and also helped calculate battery power use.
